statement: Uniformly decidable finite polynomial congruences over an effective henselian DVR with separable completion in positive characteristic give ordinary integral-point and arbitrary-projective-point decisions and full univariate factorization
notes: The residue field may be infinite. The theorem assumes explicit finite-congruence algorithms, not an isometry oracle; concrete infinite-residue fields are treated separately.

statement: Under the preceding congruence hypotheses actual central division factors and all hermitian isometries are decidable; finite-tower access also gives reduced norms and characteristic polynomials
notes: Reuses only the checked projective equations and exact witness constructions. No finite-residue hypothesis is silently retained and no main-gate movement is assigned to this abstract method.
